tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Means unfinished: progress fills, the play/resume button, the In Progress header. Never decoration or a link colour.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Icons and labels on primary, such as the play glyph.

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: Background of the In Progress section and of a row that is in progress.

tokens.name: on-primary-container
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primaryContainer.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Quiet emphasis: selected filter text, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: on-secondary
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: Navigation bar active indicator, selected chips.

tokens.name: on-secondary-container
tokens.usage: Icons and labels on secondaryContainer.

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: Means category: genre chip text and the "longest unplayed" marker. Always beside the genre name.

tokens.name: on-tertiary
tokens.usage: Text on tertiary.

tokens.name: tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Genre chip fill.

tokens.name: on-tertiary-container
tokens.usage: Genre chip label on tertiaryContainer.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Destructive actions only: delete download, unsubscribe, merge categories.

tokens.name: on-error
tokens.usage: Text on error.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Screen background behind every list and queue.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Titles and body text on any surface or surface container.

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Show names, durations, dates, time left and inactive icons.

tokens.name: surface-container-lowest
tokens.usage: Rare: content that must sit below the screen tone.

tokens.name: surface-container-low
tokens.usage: Episode rows and cards on surface.

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Navigation bar and the mini-player.

tokens.name: surface-container-high
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, menus, the category picker.

tokens.name: surface-container-highest
tokens.usage: Search field fill and the unplayed track of a progress bar.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Borders on outlined buttons and text fields.

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows.

tokens.name: inverse-surface
tokens.usage: Snackbar background ("Marked played · Undo").

tokens.name: inverse-on-surface
tokens.usage: Snackbar text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a title and its meta line.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips; between artwork and text; progress bar height is half of this.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen edge inset and row padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections (In Progress, Up Next).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Artwork thumbnails in rows, chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, the mini-player, bottom sheets, large artwork on Now Playing.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Progress bars, the play button, category chips' pill shape.

meta.source: Material 3 colour roles. Default themes: TonalSpot (2021 spec) from the brand seed teal #0f766e, primary at chroma 48, primary container at chroma 22, tertiary indigo (hue 285, chroma 44). Material You samples: TonalSpot 2021, as Android 12+ dynamicColorScheme, from wallpaper seeds #4a6fa5 and #5b7f3a; on device the wallpaper supplies these.
